description: This file defines the 'SiloOptionsLogger' class, which extends 'OptionsLogger' and implements 'ILifecycleParticipant' to participate in silo lifecycle events. It primarily sets up logging for silo options during startup.

classes.name: SiloOptionsLogger
classes.description: A class responsible for logging silo options and participating in the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes 'OnStart' method to the 'First' lifecycle stage.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Logs silo options during startup and completes immediately.
